🇦🇫🇵🇰Afghan forces strike Pakistani military bases amid renewed border clashes
Afghan forces have launched attacks on Pakistani military bases and border checkpoints from Paktika province, Afghanistan's Defense Ministry said Wednesday, as cited by Ariana News.
Kabul described the strikes as retaliation for alleged Pakistani drone attacks near Angoor Adda, claiming several Pakistani soldiers were killed or wounded and military facilities damaged.
Pakistan, meanwhile, accused Afghan forces of firing on civilian areas in South Waziristan, reportedly killing one person and injuring five others.
Neither side's claims about casualties and damage have been independently verified.

🇺🇸🇮🇷 US enforces a blockade of Iranian ports, citing 'severe' threat
The US has announced military operations to enforce a blockade across the Persian Gulf, the Strait of Hormuz, the Gulf of Oman, and the Arabian Sea, targeting Iran. It applies to all vessels, regardless of their flag or ownership.
The regional threat level has been raised to “severe.”
🗣 “Neutral vessels carrying neutral cargo or sailing in ballast between neutral ports in the Gulf of Oman and the Strait of Hormuz may be subject to questioning, visits, and searches to confirm their intentions regarding the blockade,” the Joint Maritime Information Center (JMIC) said in its announcement.
The JMIC urges ships to keep monitoring VHF Channel 16 and follow all instructions from US forces.
The US first imposed its naval blockade targeting Iranian ports and shipping on April 13. It was temporarily lifted on June 18 but reinstated on July 14.

🇮🇷🇮🇱 Israel poses a persistent risk to global energy markets – Iranian foreign minister
Abbas Araghchi has warned that possible Israeli-instigated military misadventures in the Persian Gulf region remain a threat for both gas suppliers and consumers.
The US and Israel have recently raised the [prospect of renewed attacks](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/76921) on Iran, with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu claiming that Israel has an opportunity [to eliminate the “existential threat”](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/76907) posed by Iran in cooperation with the US, according to The Times of Israel.
Meanwhile, the outcome of the Israeli general election remains unclear. Although Netanyahu's bloc appears to be leading over that of his rival, Gadi Eisenkot, neither side has yet secured the 61 seats needed for[ a parliamentary majority](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/76892).
Araghchi's remarks come in the wake of the 8th Summit of Heads of State and Government of the Gas Exporting Countries Forum (GECF) in Moscow and talks held this week in Tehran with senior officials from Iran, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey.
Previously, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian announced shared understandings with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Emir of Qatar Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani on cooperation in agriculture, oil and gas, road construction, security, and bilateral relations, according to the Tasnim News Agency.
